label: Chainlink Data Feeds requirements
summary: Atomic EVM-only requirements for one Data Feeds read path. Select it through --chainlink-product data-feeds; this definition is not current deployment evidence.
requiredFacts: Exact pair, unit, inversion, decimals, proxy, current aggregator, maximum age and economic answer range
Proxy and aggregator roles, addresses, runtime-code hashes, dependency lock and target-chain deployment evidence
Completeness, future-timestamp, non-positive-answer and stale-data rejection without treating answeredInRound as a freshness oracle
Official target-chain sequencer uptime feed and justified grace period when applicable, or evidence-bound non-applicability
Explicit independently bound fallback whose use is visible to downstream value logic
requiredFiles: Content-addressed EVM-only Chainlink provider profile selecting Data Feeds
Feed adapter source with pair, unit, inversion, decimals, age and answer-range configuration
Proxy, aggregator and optional sequencer-feed deployment evidence with runtime-code hashes
requiredTests: Wrong pair, unit, inversion, decimals, proxy, aggregator, runtime hash and target chain
Zero update timestamp, future timestamp, non-positive, stale, extreme and malformed answer
Sequencer down, grace period, missing official feed and reorg behavior when applicable
Fallback activation, attribution, stale fallback and silent-provider-substitution rejection
Bounded synchronous read behavior and no hidden external work inside PoolManager callbacks
risks: A proxy address or moving documentation page can be mistaken for current aggregator deployment evidence
Wrong units, inversion or decimals can move value despite a syntactically valid answer
Silent fallback can replace the reviewed provider and freshness model
Sequencer outages can make a recent-looking L2 answer economically unsafe
